parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(human_replies_total, 0)                             AS prev_human_total,
  COALESCE(automated_replies_total, 0)                         AS prev_auto_total,
  COALESCE(ooo_count_total, automated_replies_total, 0)        AS prev_ooo_total,
  COALESCE(prospects_total, 0)                                 AS prev_prospects_total,
  TO_CHAR(report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                          AS prev_report_date
FROM daily_stats
WHERE client_id = '{{ $('Start').item.json.client_id }}'
  AND report_date = '{{ $('Start').item.json.reportDate_firstItem }}'::date - 1
